entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 24.10.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Kharoundhi P.S. Case No.64 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 376, 328, 354, 504 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 67 of the I.T. Act.
3. It appears that the applicant aged about 18 years, is accused of committing rape upon a girl aged about 27 years being the mother of three children.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
5. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
Further, it has been submitted that the allegation is frivolous and the applicant is a student of intermediate.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

7. Considering the narratives of the case and the period of custody, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only)
with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned S.D.J.M., Nagar Untari (Garhwa) in connection with Kharoundhi P.S. Case No.64 of 2022, subject to condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
